nodes.label: Row-Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: Ensures data access boundaries are automatically and transparently enforced in PostgreSQL via static Prisma Client query extensions using logical AND condition injections to prevent search filters from bypassing security constraints.

nodes.label: Audit Log System
nodes.rationale: Captures all data modifications (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE) and admin logins on the Prisma DB layer using request-scoped Context from AsyncLocalStorage, storing before-and-after states for full traceability.

nodes.label: Revert Engine
nodes.rationale: Provides transactional undo/redo capabilities by applying the mathematical inverse of recorded database mutations (e.g. recreating deleted items with their cascading relations) in a single atomic transaction.

nodes.label: Thundering Herd Cache Protection
nodes.rationale: Utilizes an in-memory inflight-map query registry in the getCached helper function, collapsing multiple parallel requests for the same cache-missed resource into a single database trip.

nodes.label: Graceful Cache Degradation
nodes.rationale: Configures ioredis with enableOfflineQueue set to false so that if Dragonfly Redis becomes unavailable, queries do not block and immediately fall back to PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Scope Engine
nodes.rationale: Prevents cross-scope resource mutation by mapping and validating user organizational lineage (OD Region, Location, Team) against requested resource paths in a custom tRPC middleware.

nodes.label: WebAuthn Passkey Authentication
nodes.rationale: Provides secure, phishing-resistant, and passwordless authentication using public-key cryptography via WebAuthn, storing registration keys in the Passkey model.

nodes.label: Brand Identity Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Maintains strict Telekom brand compliance by wrapping brand colors (Magenta #E20074) and custom typography (TeleNeo, TeleNeo-Marker) into central CSS design variables and custom shared UI components.

nodes.label: DSGVO Datensparsamkeit
nodes.rationale: Minimizes GDPR risk by storing only essential employee auth info, hash PINs with bcryptjs, and ensuring no end-customer data enters the server database (shopping baskets are processed client-side).

nodes.label: Session Verification & Revocation
nodes.rationale: Verifies JWT session validity by querying the DB on every request, but caches this verification in Dragonfly Redis for 60 seconds with instant cache invalidation upon any user updates to avoid DB roundtrips while keeping session management secure.

nodes.label: Transactional Emails
nodes.rationale: Uses Resend API for sending employee verifications, temporary admin credentials, and account removal confirmations, establishing a reliable communication chain with business email addresses.

nodes.label: Prisma Client (Extended)
nodes.rationale: Extended statically with RLS queries and mutation interceptors on a single global database connection singleton to prevent connection pool exhaustion.

nodes.label: AuditContext Storage
nodes.rationale: Propagates request credentials down to database trigger handlers without manual parameters by utilizing thread-safe async storage context.

nodes.label: Cache Operations Helper
nodes.rationale: Protects backend from peak query loads using local promise-level memoization of inflight async queries.

nodes.label: Dragonfly Redis Client
nodes.rationale: Configured to bypass connection queue buffer on network timeouts so that temporary cache database failure has zero impact on core app availability.
